scripts.build:web: NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TARGET=web next build && node scripts/strip-admin-routes.mjs && node scripts/apply-public-site.mjs
scripts.build:pages: NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TARGET=app npm run optimize:professional-images && npm run validate:css && npm run validate:directory && npm run validate:search && npm run validate:audit && npm run validate:podcast && NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TARGET=app next build && node --import tsx scripts/export-app-data.ts && node scripts/postbuild-seo.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/validate-public-directory.ts --check-sitemap && node scripts/strip-admin-routes.mjs && node scripts/apply-public-site.mjs
scripts.build:app: npm run build:pages && npx cap sync
scripts.app:android: npm run build:app && npx cap open android
scripts.app:ios: npm run build:app && npx cap open ios
scripts.validate:release: npm run lint && npm run validate:css && npm run validate:professionals && npm run build:pages && npm run validate:seo && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint app components lib scripts tests *.ts *.mjs --no-warn-ignored
